final_message:
I fixed it in `src/wrap.py`. `wrap('aaa bbb ccc', 7)` now returns `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`, and the 5 existing tests still pass.

The line-length check was `> width - 1`, so every line was wrapped one character short of the requested width. I changed it to `> width`. I didn't add a regression test for this case.
